entity: US rural vs urban jail incarceration rates (rural about 2.5x urban)
what_we_add: the 2023 numbers, 563 vs 227 per 100K aged 15-64 in 1,906 fixed counties, and Butts GA / Yazoo MS growing about 4x on holds
why: Vera and NYT/NPQ state the same finding in the same direction: rural jail rates more than double urban, rural rising while urban falls, sustained through 2024. Our 2023 rate pair and the two named counties appear nowhere.
